name: v1.0.0-rc.37-  Pricing Configuration, Task Plugins, and Passkey
body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Pricing Configuration & Task Plugins / 定价配置与任务插件**
>
> 旧定价模式即将弃用。定价配置可将当前价格转换为计费表达式草稿，预览生效价格后再保存。新编辑器支持按条件计价、按次、含时间条件，以及图片用量与图片缓存。`gpt-image-2`、`gpt-image-2.5-sunburst`、`gpt-image-2.5-flare` 已有内置计费表达式默认值；已有管理员覆盖仍然优先。
>
> 任务插件能力增强：支持流式输出；定价配置可按任务插件设置用量价格与计费表达式；插件详情展示更新日志，缺省回退英文。创建与编辑渠道时，任务插件可参与提供商与模型选择，并带出对应插件信息。
>
> 渠道的创建与编辑已统一：共用提供商选择、分页配置、模型发现、模型重定向与参数覆盖。创建渠道时会优先使用已可用的任务插件。
>
> 安全与访问支持多个通行密钥域名。通行密钥只认创建它的网站。移除仍在使用的域名会先预览受影响数量，并要求确认；被移除域名上的通行密钥将无法继续使用。
>
> Legacy pricing will be deprecated soon. Pricing Configuration can convert current prices to an Expression draft; review the effective prices, then save to apply. The editors now support Pricing by condition, Per-request, Time-based, and image usage / image cache. `gpt-image-2`, `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst`, and `gpt-image-2.5-flare` have built-in Expression defaults; existing administrator overrides still take precedence.
>
> Task Plugins capabilities are expanded: Streaming; Usage prices and Expression in Pricing Configuration per Task Plugin; and Changelog in plugin details with an English fallback. When creating or editing a Channel, Task Plugins can take part in provider and model selection and bring along the matching plugin info.
>
> Channel create and edit are unified: shared provider selection, tabbed setup, model discovery, Model Mapping, and parameter overrides. Channel creation prefers an available Task Plugin.
>
> Security & Access supports multiple Passkey domains. Passkeys only work on the website they were created for. Removing a domain still in use previews how many Passkeys are affected and requires confirmation; Passkeys on a removed domain will stop working.

> [!WARNING]
> **Experimental Plugin System / 实验性插件系统**
>
> 自 v1.0.0-rc.27 起引入的实验性插件系统仍处于测试阶段，并涉及较大的架构调整。如遇问题，请及时反馈。
>
> 从 v1.0.0-rc.26 或更早版本升级的用户，**必须重新配置所有视频模型价格**；已完成该配置的用户无需重复操作。**本版本仍不推荐用于生产环境。**
>
> The experimental plugin system introduced in v1.0.0-rc.27 remains under testing and includes major architectural changes. Please report any issues promptly.
>
> Users upgrading from v1.0.0-rc.26 or earlier **must reconfigure all video model prices**. Users who have already completed this step do not need to repeat it. **This release is still not recommended for production use.**

## New Features

* Added Convert to expression in Pricing Configuration: review a legacy-to-Expression draft with effective prices, then save to apply it. Legacy pricing will be deprecated soon.
* Extended Expression editors and usage details: Pricing by condition, Per-request, Time-based, and image usage / image cache. Confirmation is required before replacing an Expression.
* Added built-in Expression defaults for `gpt-image-2`, `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst`, and `gpt-image-2.5-flare`, including separate text and image cache prices. Existing administrator overrides stay in place.
* Expanded Task Plugins capabilities: Streaming, Usage prices and Expression per Task Plugin, and localized Changelog (English fallback).
* Unified Channel create and edit: shared provider selection, tabbed setup, inline model discovery, Model Mapping, and parameter overrides.
* Let Task Plugins take part in Channel provider and model selection, including a gateway category and preferring available plugins for legacy task providers.
* Added System updates reminders for administrators.
* Added multiple Passkey domains in Security & Access, with impact preview and confirmation before removing a domain still in use.

## Fixes and Improvements

* Validate image quantities before reserving Quota, and keep image usage consistent through reservation, retries, and settlement.
* Stop Pricing Configuration writes from resetting or failing to persist on some long-lived deployments.
* Allow editing multi-key selection strategy without dropping existing keys; omit the strategy for single-key Channels.
* Restore the add split button in Advanced Custom ([#7289](https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/issues/7289)).
* Correct Wan model protocols and usage accounting; preserve provider fields in Sora video queries; fix VolcEngine Channel model-list fetch ([#7203](https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/issues/7203)).
* Unify server error notifications so each failed operation is reported once, while preserving backend details.
* Deduplicate `/api/status` requests ([#7189](https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/issues/7189)).
* Keep Model pricing content in one scroll area.

## What's Changed
* fix(frontend): deduplicate /api/status requests (#7157)  by @CreatorEdition in https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/pull/7189
* fix: 修正火山方舟(VolcEngine)渠道获取模型列表端点路径 404 by @captainold in https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/pull/7203
* fix: restore add split button in advanced custom routes by @seefs001 in https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/pull/7289

## New Contributors
* @captainold made their first contribution in https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/pull/7203

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/compare/v1.0.0-rc.36...v1.0.0-rc.37
